name: TICH-2
fullName: Tranexamic Acid for Hyperacute Primary Intracerebral Haemorrhage
population: n=2325, adults, NIHSS not restricted, ≤8 h from onset
teachingPoint: Tranexamic acid is not routine in spontaneous ICH — no functional benefit, though it is safe and reduces early death.

name: FASTEST
fullName: Recombinant Factor VIIa versus Placebo for Spontaneous Intracerebral Haemorrhage within 2 h of Symptom Onset
population: n=626, adults, NIHSS spontaneous ICH, ≤2 h from onset (mean 100 min)
finding: NEGATIVE: adjusted common OR 1.09; trial met prespecified futility criteria at 2nd interim analysis
teachingPoint: rFVIIa has no role in spontaneous ICH even at ≤2 h: no functional benefit, more thrombotic harm.
